verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. The pack lists filing pages (formation, foreign registration, annual reports, closures, certificates) but none shows a published current processing time or backlog for any transaction type. The only timing-related item is the in-person counter's fixed same-day service for a $150 fee. That is an adjacent paid-expedite channel, not current published processing times, so it earns no credit.
